items.t: SOFI's Q3 Loan Originations Hit Record High: Can Growth Continue?
items.sum: SoFi Technologies' Q3 2026 loan originations surged 71% to a record $16.9B, fueled by strong lending demand. Can funding strength and credit quality sustain growth?

items.t: SoFi Brings Its Bank-Issued Stablecoin to Polygon’s Payments Stack
items.sum: SoFiUSD, the first stablecoin from a U.S. national bank, is now live on Polygon Open Money Stack alongside Ethereum and Solana.

items.t: SoFi’s Bank-Issued Stablecoin SoFiUSD Goes Live on Polygon, Its Third Blockchain
items.sum: Polygon Labs says SoFi members can now buy, hold and convert SoFiUSD on Polygon in the SoFi app, which already supports the token on Ethereum and Solana.

items.t: SoFi Technologies (SOFI) Introduced The First Tokenized Deposit Product At A US Bank
items.sum: Ark Invest has recently purchased shares of SoFi Technologies (NasdaqGS:SOFI), adding the digital finance group to its actively managed portfolios. SoFi has introduced SoFi Earn, described as the first interest-bearing tokenized deposit product offered by a U.S. national bank.
